name: cuadrilla
description: An engineering team of Claude Code agents with a written standard, guardrail hooks and automated code review. Language-agnostic core plus stack packs.

plugins.name: cuadrilla
plugins.description: Core: orchestrator, reviewers, security, QA, docs, guardrail hooks, GitHub code review. Works with any language.

plugins.name: cuadrilla-python-fastapi
plugins.description: Stack pack: Python + FastAPI + PostgreSQL (psycopg 3, hand-written SQL, 4 layers, uv/ruff/mypy/pytest).

plugins.name: cuadrilla-dotnet
plugins.description: Stack pack: .NET + ASP.NET Core (4 layers, Dapper or EF Core, FluentValidation, xUnit).

plugins.name: cuadrilla-node-typescript
plugins.description: Stack pack: Node.js + TypeScript backend (layered, Zod, Kysely/SQL, Vitest).

plugins.name: cuadrilla-java-spring
plugins.description: Stack pack: Java + Spring Boot (layered, JdbcClient or JPA, Bean Validation, JUnit 5, Testcontainers).

plugins.name: cuadrilla-react
plugins.description: Stack pack: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind v4 frontend, usable with any backend pack.

plugins.name: cuadrilla-codex
plugins.description: Optional: OpenAI Codex CLI as a second executor and reviewer, always verified by Claude.
